description: Biennial. First year a basal rosette of large, thick, densely woolly grey-green leaves. Second year a single tall unbranched stem ending in a DENSE CYLINDRICAL SPIKE of 5-petalled yellow flowers opening a few at a time.
source: Flora of North America vol. 12 (Verbascum); card #27
notes: The dense cylindrical flowering spike is the identifying structure. Woolly leaves alone are ambiguous with other rosette biennials.
derived_from: botanical description and the printed card, NOT a colour signature
